description: Download a 3D model from a public https URL and measure it: volume, bounding box, surface area, triangle count, and whether the mesh is watertight. Accepts .stl and .obj. Feed surface_area_mm2 from the result into estimate_price to get an exact price instead of a range. Only well-known model-hosting and file-sharing domains can be fetched.

url.description: Public https URL to a .stl or .obj file, served as the raw file rather than as an HTML page.

name: analyze_model
title: Analyze a 3D model
